_metadata.description: Aspirational requirements: operator inspection, corpus mining, named durable sessions, and alternate kernel adapters.

requirements.title: Operator inspection surface
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY provide an operator UI for browsing sessions, program history, and the resolved binding surface.

validation.notes: Target `ui/src/features/sessions/SessionsCard.test.tsx::renders session and program history` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-001]). Operator surface lists sessions, program history, and the resolved binding surface.

requirements.title: Program corpus mining
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY analyze recurring program shapes in the corpus and propose them as skill or action candidates with their call sites as evidence.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/mining_test.go::TestProposesRecurringShapeWithCallSites` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-002]). A recurring program shape is proposed as a skill or action candidate with its call sites attached as evidence.

requirements.title: Named durable workspaces
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY support named sessions that survive across agent runs so a long investigation reuses accumulated state.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/named_test.go::TestNamedSessionSurvivesAcrossAgentRuns` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-003]). A named session is resumable by a later agent run with its accumulated state intact.

requirements.title: Alternate kernel adapters
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY support kernel languages beyond Python where a measured capability argument justifies the added surface.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/adapter_test.go::TestKernelAdapterSeamIsLanguageNeutral` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-004]). The kernel adapter seam admits a non-Python kernel without changes to bindings or governance.
